Subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference - Procurement & Billing Qs

Hi Dana / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — great conversation. Quick recap + next steps so we can get you into a trial and a scoped pilot: 

- Demo highlights: standard throughput/latency profile shared (see recording), recommended model + estimated monthly token volume.
- Procurement & commercial questions we need to confirm before kickoff:
  • Procurement path: PO vs card vs marketplace (do you prefer a PO through SSO procurement or paying by credit card / AWS Marketplace?).
  • Billing terms: do you require net terms (Net30/Net45), and any specific invoice format (line-item granularity, VAT fields, billing contact)?
  • Entity + billing address + VAT ID we should put on the invoice.
  • Any internal legal redlines we should expect on the MSA? (I attached the current MSA draft for reference.)

Attachments: Redwood_Master_Services_Agreement_v1.pdf, Sample_Invoice_Acme.pdf

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Can you confirm your preferred commercial path (PO / card / AWS Marketplace)?
2) If PO, can you share a PO template or the billing contact who issues POs?
3) Please confirm billing address and tax/VAT ID so we can generate a sample invoice for finance.

If easier, we can loop in your procurement contact on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the process.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your details and will coordinate legal/finance on our side (cc'd).

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@acmeanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference - Procurement & Billing Qs

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few items from procurement/finance side: 

- Preferred payment method: Purchase Order is our standard for new vendors. We can do card for small pilots, but for anything >$10k we use a PO.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30, but we can discuss Net45 if needed — finance will sign off after vendor onboarding.
- Invoice requirements: please include full vendor name, tax/VAT fields, purchase order number (when provided), and line items (service, period, and total). We also need the invoice as a PDF and emailed to procurement@acmeanalytics.com and accounts-payable@acmeanalytics.com.
- Billing address + VAT: can provide below in separate message (we pull that from finance).
- Marketplace: we use AWS Marketplace for some purchases — is Redwood available there? If yes, we prefer going through marketplace for easier procurement and consolidated billing.

One more: would you be able to accept our standard PO template? I can attach it if that helps.

Thanks,
Dana
Senior Product Manager | Acme Analytics
dana.lewis@acmeanalytics.com

Thanks Dana — helpful. A couple quick clarifications and proposed path: 

- PO path works fine. We typically accept POs and will mirror the PO number on the invoice. If you can share your PO template (or an example), I’ll pass it to our finance team to confirm compatibility.
- Net30 is standard; we can request Net30 approval now. For customers who need Net45/Net60 we run a brief credit review — happy to start that if you prefer.
- AWS Marketplace: Redwood is currently evaluating marketplace listings; we do have some models through partners, but we don’t yet have our full commercial offering centralized on AWS Marketplace. I can flag this as an ask with our GTM team — if marketplace is a hard requirement, let me know and I’ll prioritize.
- Invoice contents: we can produce PDF invoices that include: vendor legal name, Redwood tax ID, line items (service description, period, unit price, quantity, total), PO number, VAT fields. Example attached (Sample_Invoice_Acme.pdf).
- For the MSA: I’ve attached our latest MSA (Redwood_Master_Services_Agreement_v1.pdf). If you have redlines, please send them back to me or to legal@redwood-inference.com and I’ll shepherd them.

Next steps I propose:
1) Dana / procurement: send the PO template and billing address + VAT ID (or I can draft a sample invoice if you share billing details).
2) If PO: procurement shares PO template and expected signatory (procurement or legal).
3) I’ll put together an order form once billing details and PO path are confirmed and route to finance for Net30 approval if needed.

I’ve attached a blank Order_Form_Acme_2026.docx as a starting point — feel free to populate and return.

Best,
Marissa
